messages.回避で「時限漂流」を得て、味方の攻撃に合わせてS1「次元斬り」で追撃し、充電を稼: A Charge Identity that gains Dimensional Castaway by evading, then follows up allies' attacks with S1 Dimensional Slice to build Charge. Use enhanced S3 at 15 Charge Count, then continue the evade-and-follow-up cycle.
messages.守備「回避」: 戦闘開始時に時限漂流1・四色次元1を得る(充電威力3以上なら追加: **Defense skill — Sidestep**: At Combat Start, he gains 1 Dimensional Castaway and 1 Quadricolor Dimensions (1 more with 3 or more Charge Potency, once per turn). If his Charge Count is below 7, he spends HP to refill it to 7, and if it exceeds 15, he spends 10 of the excess to recover HP and gain Haste next turn. He also gains Charge Barrier equal to his Charge Potency, up to 5.
messages.追撃: 常時発動パッシブ「貫かれし路地」により、自分以外の味方のスキルが敵に的中: **Follow-ups**: Through the always-active passive Open Alley, when an ally other than himself hits an enemy with a skill, he spends 1 Dimensional Castaway to trigger Dimensional Slice on that target and gains 1 Quadricolor Dimensions.
messages.S1「次元斬り」: 使用時に充電回数を2消耗し、Ⅰコイン的中時に6増加(スキルご: **S1 — Dimensional Slice**: Spends 2 Charge Count on use and gains 6 on Coin Ⅰ hit (once per skill). With Dimensional Castaway, it spends 1 to reuse Coin Ⅰ (once per skill). The follow-up trigger also spends 1 Dimensional Castaway, so a follow-up S1 only reaches the reuse at 3 or more Charge Potency, when Sidestep grants 2 Dimensional Castaway.
messages.充電威力と四色次元: 戦闘中、累計で充電回数を10消耗するたびに充電威力1を得る: **Charge Potency and Quadricolor Dimensions**: During battle, he gains 1 Charge Potency each time he spends a cumulative 10 Charge Count. Quadricolor Dimensions (max 4, decreasing by 1 at Turn End) raises Offense Level, Defense Level, and Charge Count gain based on its value, and at 4 or more, his skills deal +(Charge Potency×4)% damage, up to 20%.
messages.S3「空間切断」: 充電回数が15以上なら「四次角歪曲時系列切断」(4コインの広: **S3 — Rip Space**: With 15 or more Charge Count, it activates as Four-dimensional Refraction Time Series Severance (a 4-Coin Unfocused Volley that spends 15 Charge Count), gaining 1 Quadricolor Dimensions on each hit with Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ. Coin Ⅳ is reused at 5 or more Charge Potency (once per skill). With 7–14, it becomes the regular version that spends all Charge Count.
messages.手元のS1は基本的に守備(回避)へ回すとよい。回避で時限漂流を得て、味方の攻撃に: It works well to basically turn the S1s in hand into his Defense skill (Sidestep). Gain Dimensional Castaway with Sidestep and earn Charge Count through Dimensional Slice follow-ups timed with allies' attacks. Sidestep refills Charge Count to 7, so combined with the follow-ups, Charge builds quickly. Once Charge Count reaches 15, fire the enhanced S3, then return to Sidestep and follow-ups. As he keeps spending, Charge Potency grows and he meets the reuse conditions for the follow-ups and enhanced S3. S2 Consecutive Dimensional Slice spends 5 Charge Count but only gains 6, a poor return. Treat it as a Clash skill for raising SP. This Identity has no way to restore SP, so he needs to secure SP through Clashes against weak skills or rely on allies' support. Rupture infliction is only a side effect.
